answer: Each new key must carry a 90-day surety policy signed by one of 40 bonded underwriters. The premium for the k-th key sharing a funding or device cluster is 5×2^(k-1) credits, so a raven-black swarm cannot forge 10 aliases without 5,115 credits. A public garden registry rejects reused policy serials. Each epoch, a beacon assigns two underwriters to audit device quotes and funding paths; either may publish signed duplicate evidence. Validators verify signatures and reserve proofs, merge linked keys, and slash 60% of an underwriter's bond after two bad policies.
